speaker: richard_burbage
text: You are off. Stay off. The end is a short road from here, and it does not need another man in the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am off. I am not going out to look at them. Tell me when the yard is to be let, and not what they laughed at.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: They are still in it. I have nothing left of mine. I will not say a line in here to keep my mouth warm.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Keep it cold. The paint is still on thee, and on me, and the coat has its stitch. That is the whole of the news in this room.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: John is by the outer door, and George with him. When they let the yard out, we are done. I am not making a speech to a room that has finished its work.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. I will stand until they call it. I have no story for anyone yet. I do not want one invented for me before the doors open.
